solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Panelling in baby Rooney's bed, from what we hear?

indicators.note: the clue asks us to listen, so the words are a sound-alike for the entry

parts.note: a baby's bed is a cot, and footballer Wayne Rooney's would be Wayne's cot

explanation.surface: A footballer's toddler's cot seems to be trimmed with wood panelling.
explanation.walkthrough: Wayne Rooney is a famous England footballer; WAYNE'S COT spoken sounds like the panelling word.
explanation.definitionFit: Wainscot is wooden panelling lining the lower part of a room's walls.

clue.text: Awkward moving about? A cab will have to get caught

parts.note: a cab is a taxi
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: A clumsy passenger is told a taxi must be taken.
explanation.definitionFit: Ataxia is a medical lack of muscle coordination, making movement clumsy and unsteady.

clue.text: Irish missionary upsets this Eastern European girl

indicators.note: in a down clue, upsetting a word turns it upside down, so its letters are read backwards

parts.note: St Aidan was an Irish monk who took Christianity to Northumbria

explanation.surface: A missionary from Ireland disturbs a girl from Eastern Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: Nadia is a girl's first name of Slavic origin, common in Russia and Eastern Europe.

clue.text: One sending something to trick a gentleman of Verona?

parts.note: to con is to trick
an Italian gentleman, as in Verona, is a signor

explanation.surface: A sender of goods plays a trick on one of Shakespeare's two gentlemen of Verona.
explanation.definitionFit: A consignor is the party who dispatches goods to a recipient.

clue.text: Man starts to educate novices in an hour of devotion

indicators.note: the opening letters are placed within the word for the prayer hour

parts.note: terce is the canonical prayer hour said at the third hour of the day

indicators.note: the starts of the words educate and novices give their initial letters

explanation.surface: A teacher begins lessons for novices during a prayer service.
explanation.walkthrough: TERCE is one of the canonical hours of monastic prayer.
explanation.definitionFit: Terence is a male first name, so a man in crossword shorthand.

clue.text: Cost has to be pegged back if there's discount

indicators.note: the word for cost holds the turned-round piece inside it

parts.note: a rate is a cost or charge

indicators.note: pegged back means pushed backwards, so the little word reads in reverse

explanation.surface: A shopper hopes prices are held down if there is a reduction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pegged back' reads like prices held down, but it turns the little word 'be' round; 'has' then holds it inside the word for cost.
explanation.definitionFit: A rebate is a partial refund or reduction on a payment.

clue.text: From what is said, many workers demand these observances

indicators.note: the clue relies on speech, so a word that sounds the same is entered

parts.note: workers campaigning demand their rights

explanation.surface: Many workers are said to be demanding certain things.
explanation.definitionFit: Rites are ceremonial religious observances or rituals.

clue.text: Singer injected with British drug

indicators.note: the singer is given a shot of the abbreviation, which goes inside

parts.note: a baritone is a male singer

explanation.surface: A singer is given an injection of a British drug.
explanation.definitionFit: Barbitone is a barbiturate sedative, an old sleeping drug.

clue.text: Pheasant in a pot gran cooked

indicators.note: cooked suggests the letters are mixed up as in a recipe

explanation.surface: A grandmother is cooking a pheasant in a pot.
explanation.definitionFit: The tragopan is an Asian horned pheasant with brightly coloured plumage.

clue.text: What many a prisoner would like, eh?

definitions.text: What many a prisoner would like
definitions.meaning: a prisoner hopes for an official release from the sentence
an exclamation asking someone to repeat what they said

explanation.surface: A wry aside on what most inmates long for.
explanation.definitionFit: A pardon frees a convict; 'Pardon?' asks for a remark to be repeated.

clue.text: Nonsense by unorthodox believer who belongs to club?

parts.note: rot is nonsense
an Arian follows the heresy of Arius, who denied Christ's full divinity

explanation.surface: Rubbish spoken by a heretic who is a club member.
explanation.definitionFit: A Rotarian is a member of the Rotary Club, a service organisation.

clue.text: Drink brings freedom with loss of hesitation

indicators.note: losing the hesitation sound means those letters drop out of the freedom word

parts.note: liberation is freedom
er is the sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: Alcohol brings liberty once you stop hesitating.
explanation.definitionFit: A libation is a drink, originally one poured as an offering to a god.

clue.text: Foreign city journey — very good person will be around shortly

indicators.note: the shortened holy person surrounds the journey word
shortly means cut short, losing the final letter

parts.note: a saint is a very good person
to go is to journey

explanation.surface: A trip to a city abroad where a good person will soon be found.
explanation.definitionFit: Saigon, now Ho Chi Minh City, is a city in Vietnam.

clue.text: Mainstream religious house on holy island by lake

parts.note: a convent is a religious house
Iona is the Scottish island where St Columba founded a monastery

explanation.surface: An orthodox religious community stands on a sacred island beside a lake.
explanation.definitionFit: Conventional means mainstream, following what is generally done.

clue.text: Can't get on unfortunately with a concept in trigonometry

indicators.note: unfortunately suggests things gone awry, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A student laments failing to get on with a trigonometry idea.
explanation.definitionFit: The cotangent is the trigonometric ratio of adjacent to opposite side, the reciprocal of tangent.

clue.text: No writer should get involved in row — one may need to work before lunch!

definitions.text: one may need to work before lunch!

indicators.note: getting involved in a row means going inside it

parts.note: a tier is a row
taken as written
a pen is a writer

explanation.surface: An author should stay out of a quarrel, as there is work to do before lunch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Row' looks like a quarrel but is a tier, a row of seats; the definition pictures opening a can for a meal.
explanation.definitionFit: A kitchen gadget for cutting open cans has to be worked before a canned lunch can be eaten.

clue.text: Quiet member of small community knocking out very violent robber?

parts.note: p (piano) is the musical marking for quiet

indicators.note: knocking out removes that letter from the community member

parts.note: a villager lives in a small community

explanation.surface: A quiet villager turns out to be a very violent robber.
explanation.definitionFit: A pillager plunders by force, looting violently.

clue.text: Eater to bring novel form of fruit

indicators.note: a novel form is a new arrangement, so the letters are reshuffled

explanation.surface: A diner is asked to bring an unusual kind of fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: The Seville orange, sour-tasting and used for marmalade, is a citrus fruit.

clue.text: Gives a new part to fantastic actress

indicators.note: fantastic suggests something wildly altered, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A director hands a fresh role to a marvellous actress.
explanation.definitionFit: To recast is to assign an actor a different role or replace the cast.

clue.text: Academic falling into clutches of a French female is ruined

indicators.note: being held in someone's clutches means sitting inside them

parts.note: une is French for 'a' with a feminine noun
a don is a university academic

explanation.surface: A lecturer is ruined after falling for a Frenchwoman.
explanation.definitionFit: To be undone is to be ruined or brought to destruction.

clue.text: Design by leading pair of architects for flat

parts.note: a plan is a design

indicators.note: the leading pair are the first two letters of the word architects

explanation.surface: Architects draw up plans for an apartment.
explanation.definitionFit: Planar means lying in a plane, so level or flat.

clue.text: Solid stuff in Religious Education on 'estrangement from God'

parts.note: RE is the abbreviation for Religious Education, a school subject
sin is seen as separation from God

explanation.surface: A school RE lesson on sin as separation from God.
explanation.definitionFit: Resin is a sticky substance that hardens into a solid.

clue.text: Point at band dancing

parts.note: a cape is a point of land jutting into the sea
a ring is a band

explanation.surface: Pointing at a band that is dancing.
explanation.definitionFit: Capering is skipping or leaping about playfully.

clue.text: Arrest creates altercation

definitions.meaning: a ... with the police is an arrest

explanation.surface: A police arrest leads to a row.
explanation.definitionFit: A run-in is an encounter with police and also a quarrel or dispute.

clue.text: Accidentally see gross females you'd rather avoid

indicators.note: accidentally means by chance, so the letters fall into a new order

explanation.surface: Unfortunate women you would rather avoid catching sight of.
explanation.definitionFit: Ogresses are female monsters, and so women best avoided.

clue.text: Officer from London on committee

indicators.note: the officer is taken from within the run of letters of the words London on committee

explanation.surface: An officer from London sits on a committee.
explanation.definitionFit: A non-com is a non-commissioned officer such as a sergeant or corporal.

clue.text: Dish with corn — time to tuck in

indicators.note: the abbreviation is tucked inside the cereal word

parts.note: corn is grain

explanation.surface: A dinner of corn, and time to eat up.
explanation.definitionFit: A gratin is a dish topped with a browned crust of breadcrumbs or cheese.

clue.text: Journalist — person on phone at end of street?

indicators.note: the caller comes at the end, after the street abbreviation

parts.note: a ringer is someone who rings on the phone

explanation.surface: A reporter on the phone at the bottom of the road.
explanation.definitionFit: A stringer is a freelance journalist paid per item for a newspaper.
